# Lithium Lasers – Ultra pulses, pure impact.

Why us

## The most tunable and adaptable femtosecond lasers for your applications

You get more than advanced laser technology. You gain a next-generation, flexible system designed to tackle real industrial challenges and elevate your precision and productivity.

![](https://lithiumlasers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Lithium-Lasers_Grafica-Why-us.webp)

Benefits

With the **most flexible** lasers and an **in-house Micro-processing lab**, we empower users with greater freedom to process new materials and unlock innovative applications. Dive into the future of precision and fast processing with our unique, forward-thinking solutions.

### Best  Flexibility

The most flexible burst modulation enables **precise tuning** to meet process requirements.

### High  Speed

GHz operation and Full Burst Control ensure every watt is used efficiently for **faster processing and not lost** as unwanted heat.

### High  Precision

Ultrashort laser pulses enable precise material removal **without heat** or burrs.

### Reduced  Footprint

The **unique laser design** reduces size, weight, and energy consumption.

### Reduced  Costs

Faster results and **no post-processing** cut waste save time and reduce costs.

### Skilled  Support Team

From process tuning to installation, our expert team delivers **optimal solutions** for your application.

![](https://lithiumlasers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Lithium-Lasers_Our-technology-grafica.svg)

Our technology

## Ultra-Flexible GHz Burst Femtosecond Laser

A patented laser design for GHz burst technology.

Our **patented FULL GHz burst-modulation** technology delivers unparalleled control and flexibility, giving you the freedom to optimize laser processing. This guarantees **top performance even on the toughest and most advanced materials**.

![](https://lithiumlasers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Lithium-lasers-Home-laser-process.gif)

Experience ultra-precise, highly efficient material processing with minimal heat damage.

[See how it works](https://lithiumlasers.com/technology/)

### [See how it works](https://lithiumlasers.com/technology/)

Femto lasers

Lithium Lasers delivers next-generation femtosecond laser systems that combine ultra-high repetition rates, high-power, and an exceptionally compact design. Whether you’re advancing additive nanomanufacturing or pushing the limits of subtractive micromachining, explore our cutting-edge solutions built for speed and precision.

![](https://lithiumlasers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Lithium-Lasers_Lithiumsix-cover.webp)

## [Lithiumsix](https://lithiumlasers.com/lithiumsix/)

High frequency laser for 3D Nanoprinting

KEY FEATURES

Ultrashort pulses: <200 fs.
High repetition rate: 210 MHz — 3× faster than standard systems.
High output power: more than to 7 W (IR) / 3.5 W (Green).
Active Power Control: closed-loop feedback system ensuring long-term output stability and consistent pulse energy, even under varying environmental conditions.
Ultra-low beam pointing drift under temperature variations: <1.5 µrad/°C.

STRENGHTS

High power and frequency in one compact source — delivering more than 7 W and 210 MHz for unmatched throughput and resolution.
Best-in-class beam pointing stability ensures consistent results on the target, ideal for 24/7 industrial operation.
Active Power Control maintains constant output and pulse energy, minimizing drift and maximizing process reproducibility.
Exceptional stability from the optimized cavity design makes it ideal for threshold-sensitive processes where power fluctuations are critical.
All-in-one, shoe-box-sized housing for reliable performance in demanding environments.

[Discover the product](https://lithiumlasers.com/lithiumsix/)

### [Discover the product](https://lithiumlasers.com/lithiumsix/)

![](https://lithiumlasers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Lithium-Lasers_Femtoflash-cover.webp)

## [Femtoflash](https://lithiumlasers.com/femtoflash/)

GHz Burst laser for microprocessing

KEY FEATURES

FULL GHz Burst modulation: Burst repetition rate continuous tuning from 2 KHz to 10 MHz. Burst length: from 20 pulses to continuous GHz pulse trains Intra-burst energy.
Profile: rising, descending, constant, or programmable offsets.
High output power (up to 100 W) and best-in-class burst energy (up to 10 mJ).
GHz repetition rate.
Ultrashort pulses (< 800 fs).
Unique patented design.

STRENGHTS

Total process control with FULL GHz Burst modulation — freely tunable burst repetition rate, burst length, and intra-burst energy profile.
Programmable Energy Delivery — customizable intra-burst profiles (rising, descending, constant, or programmable) ensure perfect adaptation to any process or material.
Unmatched throughput and efficiency with high output power (up to 100 W) and best-in-class burst energy (15 mJ).
Optimized process performance enabled by GHz repetition rates.
Superior machining precision with ultrashort < 800 fs pulses effective on all material types.
All-in-one, shoe-box-sized housing for maximum reliability, 24/7 operation and easy integration.

[Discover the product](https://lithiumlasers.com/femtoflash/)
